metric_definitions.accepted_bridge_count: two-sided source support after semantic-object and direct-prior-art rejection
metric_definitions.direct_prior_art_count: candidate bridges already stated by a primary source
metric_definitions.leakage_count: claims relying on post-cutoff or unbound source material
metric_definitions.two_sided_supported_count: candidate bridges with literal support on both sides before semantic review

selection_decision: primary apparent overlap failed semantic-object review; backup was direct prior art; neither outperformed the rejection controls
time_sliced_rediscovery_limitation: not measurable because no candidate bridge was accepted and no held-out rediscovery benchmark exists
